## Known limitations / residual risks
1. **DNS rebinding** — SSRF allowlist validated at request-construction time only. A compromised DNS could re-resolve after validation. Network-level controls (Supabase Edge Function outbound routing) are outside application scope.
2. **SSH root password auth** — VPS uses password-based root SSH. This is a security risk. Recommend adding SSH key and disabling password auth (manual action by operator).
3. **No local DB for SQL test execution** — All SQL tests passed static review but were not executed against PostgreSQL. Must be run against staging before production migration.
4. **`wa_credential_key` not yet configured** — WhatsApp credential operations are blocked until `ALTER ROLE authenticator SET app.wa_credential_key = '...'` is executed in production Supabase.
5. **5 migrations not yet applied to production** — Production currently has no application tables (last verified). Apply only after staging validation.
